name: I place your religion, your...
arabic: (( أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ)).

transliterations.latin: Estevdi ull-llahe dineke ve emaneteke, ve havatime amelike

translations.albanian: Në mbrojtjen e Allahut qofshin feja jote, besa jote dhe përfundimi i punëve tuaja.
translations.english: (I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.)
translations.indonesian: Aku menitipkan agamamu, amanatmu dan perbuatanmu yang terakhir kepada Allah.
